test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 10 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

As a preliminary to negotiation, the government was required to _______ all the obnoxious measures.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'.** i.e.** 'Rescind'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In the context** of this sentence, the government needs to reverse or cancel some actions (measures) that are considered obnoxious or unpleasant.
 
• The word** 'rescind'** means to revoke, cancel, or repeal, which fits perfectly into this context.

Therefore, the **correct sentence **will be: *"As a preliminary to negotiation, the government was required to rescind all the obnoxious measures."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 'Option 2', **'requisite'** means required, necessary and is not suitable because it doesn't fit the sentence's context.
 
• 'Option 3', **'quaint'** means attractively unusual or old-fashioned; in this context, it makes no sense.
 
• 'Option 4' **'repeat'** is not suitable because it won't make sense in this sentence.
